MATCH (spec:Spec {specNumber: '38.413'})
WHERE spec.specRelease =~ 'Rel-[0-9]+'
WITH spec, toInteger(substring(spec.specRelease, 4)) AS releaseNumber
ORDER BY releaseNumber DESC, spec.id ASC
LIMIT 1
MATCH (spec)-[:HAS_SECTION]->(section:Section {sectionNumber: '9.3.1'})
WITH DISTINCT section
ORDER BY section.sectionId ASC
LIMIT 1
MATCH (section)-[:HAS_SUB_SECTION]->(child:Section)
RETURN DISTINCT child.sectionId AS sectionId, child.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber, child.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle
